message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Making software tools and AI agents work smoothly in daily workflows is a challenge for many viewers. Your video on testing OpenAI Dots caught our attention. We work with EDXSO alongside teachers and academic leaders on sustainable institutional growth and academic outcomes. We are exploring an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, giving your audience practical technology insights for schools. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
